Network tokens are sent only over HTTPS. Plain HTTP is accepted only on this device’s loopback address.
Publicly trusted HTTPS needs no extra setup. For a private Covalent certificate, enroll exactly one CA certificate or SHA-256 certificate pin. Android still verifies the URL hostname.
Or use an exact certificate pin
The pin must match a certificate in the presented chain. No trust-all mode is available.
For the packaged Caddy endpoint, securely copy /config/caddy/data/caddy/pki/authorities/local/root.crt and use the exact HTTPS host configured by COVALENT_HTTPS_HOST.
